evidence: Homepage lists heritage items with an accurate visible result count matching the number of rendered cards.
Clicking a loaded hotspot opens an information overlay showing title, image, category, region, brief description, and a "查看详情" action to view full details.
Detail pages (e.g. /heritage/peking-opera, /heritage/suzhou-embroidery) show matching title, full introduction, category, region, inclusion year, and a multi-image gallery.
Search, category/region filters, and sort by name/year/region all update the displayed item list and result count accordingly.
Navigating back from a detail page to the panorama restores the previous camera rotation (translateX) and zoom (scale) values.
All displayed heritage items' category values fall within the four supported categories: Traditional Crafts, Performing Arts, Folk Activities, Traditional Art.
Valid slugs open the matching heritage item; an invalid slug shows "未找到该非遗项目" with a "返回首页" link back to the homepage, with no unrelated project details shown.
Each heritage card displays title, brief description, region/province, and category.
Category-browsing navigation link on a detail page returns the user to the homepage project list.

issue: Hotspots permanently disappear after sufficient panorama rotation
actual: After repeated drag-to-rotate sessions moving translateX past approximately -90px to -135px, all panorama hotspots vanish from the DOM and never reappear, even when dragging in the reverse direction back through translateX values (e.g., -360px through -135px) that previously showed hotspots when first reached in the forward direction. Zoom controls alone work correctly, but combined with rotation, hotspots become permanently unrecoverable within the session.
evidence: Controlled 8-session drag test: translateX progressed -90px (hotspots "端端,春春" visible) → -135px (hotspots empty) → ... → -405px (empty). Reversal test dragging back from -405px to -135px confirmed hotspots remained empty at all points, including translateX values that previously showed hotspots when first reached going forward.
Selecting each gallery thumbnail updates the main image area; forcing an invalid image src produces an explicit "图片加载失败" failure state.
Search/filter/sort selections remain applied after opening a heritage detail page and returning to the project list via browser back navigation.
Images shown for heritage items (e.g. Peking Opera, Suzhou Embroidery) are thematically consistent with the item's name and description.
